The number of full screen display modes. Use [GfxModeWidth](GfxModeWidth), [GfxModeHeight](GfxModeHeight) and [GfxModeDepth](GfxModeDepth) with a number from 1 to this value to learn what each mode is.

```blitzbasic
Print CountGfxModes() + " graphics modes"
For m = 1 To CountGfxModes()
	Print m + ": " + GfxModeWidth(m) + " x " + GfxModeHeight(m) + " x " + GfxModeDepth(m)
Next
WaitKey
```
@returns The number of modes.
@gap The modes are the ones of the main display. When they cannot be asked, for example without a display, a list of common sizes is given: 640x480, 800x600, 1024x768, 1280x720, 1280x1024 and 1920x1080.
